title: a CHARGED OFF and FRAUD loan's credit balance refund posts principal 250.0 -> DEBIT 11 250.0, CREDIT 4 250.0 (loan 27 L169)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a loan CREDIT BALANCE REFUND posted, ported from createJournalEntriesForLoanCreditBalanceRefund (AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan.java:2113-2170, pinned 426a23544), on the Tier-D `LoanCBR.feature` MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits). request.credit_balance_refund_journal.transaction_id is L169, the sweep transactionId of the read-back's transaction id 169 (type loanTransactionType.creditBalanceRefund, amount 250.0). The portions transcribe principalPortion 25000 and overpaymentPortion 0 of that read-back transaction, converted from the decimal major units to integer minor units by exact decimal parsing (never a float); the observed identity amount = principal + overpayment holds (25000 = 25000 + 0). The loan is CHARGED OFF and FRAUD (read-back chargedOff true, fraud true), so determineAccrualAccountForCBR sends the principal debit to LOAN_PORTFOLIO 5 / CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE 11. The refund was posted with paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 6 (AUTOPAY), which has NO channel mapping (the only channel mapping in the product is paymentTypeId 1 -> 19), so the default product FUND_SOURCE 4 is credited, exactly the account the observed credit names. request.credit_balance_refund_journal.accounts transcribes the accepted product mapping .softhouse/capture/tierd-feasibility/cbr-mnt/product-mappings/create-request-LP2_DOWNPAYMENT_AUTO_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION.json (sha256 c5166cc79a8c5ca33c1ae36f5ce898be42fcf92d5cd61df602edf52c35a85b94): fundSourceAccountId 4, loanPortfolioAccountId 5, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 16, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 15, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 11. expect.credit_balance_refund_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the posting legs under L169 in id order: DEBIT account 11 250.0; CREDIT account 4 250.0. This vector grades ONE property: the principal portion switches from LOAN_PORTFOLIO 5 to CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE 15 once the loan is charged off, and to CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE 11 when it is also fraud, while the overpayment debit and the single total credit to the fund source are unchanged. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
